Place: a misty enchanted garden of moss, ivy and lanterns
Time of day: golden hour — warm low sun, long shadows; the warm low sun rim-lighting her hair.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: your own design — create a revealing, fashionable outfit for this place and moment, as daring as the scene allows: a figure-hugging cut with bare skin by design (neckline, shoulders, midriff or legs), styled with care. BOTH HANDS: both hands brace on the edge on either side of her hips.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: lidded half-open eyes, slack mouth, brows flat and unengaged. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; nothing slipped off; chest and pelvis covered
action_level: mostly posed — a paused or held moment of the selected activity
source_influence: balanced — her species shows as one accessory and one object in the scene; the outfit keeps its own colours and patterns
separates_preference: balanced — choose either a one-piece outfit or separates to suit the scene

Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her source belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus; where the place is busy, a few background people may share the scene — same ground, light and style, sized for their distance, busy with their own activity, never facing the camera or posing beside her; quiet or private places stay empty.
